features.title: Generous seating for family comfort
features.text: Extra-wide seating with roomy cushions offers plenty of space for three, making it perfect for family nights or hosting guests.

features.title: Soft wrinkles for relaxed comfort
features.text: Wrinkled backrest design adds charm while adjusting softly to your posture, creating a lived-in, cozy feel.

features.title: Pocket-spring bounce for ease
features.text: Springs inside foam add buoyancy to seating, so you never feel stiff, even during long hours of sitting.

features.title: Symmetrical stitching adds style
features.text: Fine, even stitching lifts the sofa’s look, making it as elegant as it is comfortable in your living space.

features.title: Forest green that refreshes mood
features.text: This bold, refreshing color turns the sofa into a statement, brightening your room and energizing your décor.
